dataset_info.name: Bharatanatyam body-error sample training data
dataset_info.task: Classify one learner clip (compared with its reference video) as correct, timing, posture or range_of_motion error
dataset_info.IMPORTANT: SIMULATED sample data for demonstrating the data format and ML workflow. It is NOT recorded from real dancers and must not be presented as real data or used to report model accuracy.

labels.correct: performance matches the reference within normal variation
labels.timing: danced clearly slower or faster than the reference
labels.posture: one or more joints held at a consistently wrong angle
labels.range_of_motion: a movement is clearly too small or too large

dataset_info.label_noise_note: about 4% of labels in the source data are deliberately wrong, like real annotation disagreement
dataset_info.recommended_split: split by performer_id (GroupKFold), never by clip, so test performers are unseen

feature_definitions.dev_signed_deg: mean (learner angle - reference angle) after DTW alignment, degrees. Positive = learner joint too straight, negative = too bent
feature_definitions.dev_abs_deg: mean absolute angle difference after DTW alignment, degrees
feature_definitions.rom_ratio: learner range of motion divided by reference range of motion (1.0 = same)
feature_definitions.duration_ratio: learner duration divided by reference duration (>1 = slower)
feature_definitions.warp_dev: how uneven the timing is: mean gap between normalised learner and reference time along the DTW path
feature_definitions.dtw_cost_deg: mean DTW cost along the warping path, degrees

deviation_sequence_16_steps.description: joint-angle deviation (learner - reference) along the DTW-aligned path, resampled to 16 steps, plus the time-warp slope. Input format for an LSTM

dataset_info.angle_definition: angle at the middle landmark of three MediaPipe Pose points, in degrees (for example left_knee = hip-knee-ankle)
dataset_info.source: generated by make_sample_dataset.py using the project's own evaluator
